Measured: a referenced label before only those two refreshes gives 0 (two gotos), and the second base used only for the two swc1 8(s0) stores gives 0. A single-base body therefore needs at least two block splits or non-candidate loads. The vx arms 0xac4-0xad8 and 0xaf4-0xb04 are each a single block ending in b b08 or fallthrough with no zero-code join, so any natural split adds a branch. The other route, a final if (player->flying) whose PRE fills 0xa40/0xa9c/0xac8/0xaf8, keeps the 0x9f0 read alive only with a consumer. In the target, v0 from 0x9f0 is read only by beqz v0 at 0xb0c on the vx==0 path; the call arguments (lw a1,48(s0) at 0xa3c/0xa98, after sw 24(s0)) and line 318 (lw t1,48(s0) at 0xc18) reload. One tagged second variable (1 site) stays the minimum. variants.py scan of the Family Z body: 120 variants, best 2.
